clue.text: Either end of a carton of cereal?

indicators.note: end of a carton points first to the opening letter of the word carton

parts.note: Either ... or: the word Either calls up its partner, the word or

indicators.note: the same end-of phrase read again points to the closing letter of the word carton

explanation.surface: A shopper wonders whether either end of a cereal packet is the one to open.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Either end' is read literally: C OR N, the first letter, OR, then the last letter of carton.
explanation.definitionFit: Maize and other grain crops are known as corn, a staple cereal.

clue.text: My family, it's not good with vegetarian food

definitions.text: My family, it's not good with vegetarian food

parts.words: My family, it's not good with vegetarian food
parts.note: one's relatives are one's own meat-and-gore kin, and meat and gore are exactly what a vegetarian meal lacks

explanation.surface: Someone complains that their relatives never cope with a meat-free dinner.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase meaning close relatives is read literally as meat and gore, which no vegetarian dish contains.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom 'my own' kith phrase means blood relatives, i.e. family, while literally naming animal tissue unsuited to vegetarians.

clue.text: Side dish of potato served without wings

indicators.note: wings are the two outer letters at either side, which are dropped here

parts.note: potato wedges are a side dish of chunky fried potato

explanation.surface: A menu offers a side of potato wedges, served trimmed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Side dish' looks like one phrase, but 'Side' alone is the definition; 'without wings' removes the W and S from WEDGES.
explanation.definitionFit: A side or border of something is its rim or margin, a synonym.

clue.text: Spooner to attack chef: record number of beans here

indicators.note: the Reverend Spooner swapped the opening sounds of words, so the two words found are switched at their starts

parts.note: to bash is to attack
a chef is a cook

explanation.surface: Someone attacks a chef and then turns to counting the beans in stock.
explanation.walkthrough: BASH COOK with initial letters swapped gives CASH BOOK. 'Beans' is slang for money, as in 'not a bean'.
explanation.definitionFit: A ledger listing money received and paid out is where sums of money are written down.

clue.text: Sunday's child is a pain

parts.note: S is the standard abbreviation for Sunday
titch is British slang for a small child

explanation.surface: A nod to the rhyme 'Sunday's child is bonny and blithe', here turned sour.
explanation.walkthrough: TITCH is informal British for a very small person, often a child.
explanation.definitionFit: A sharp ache in the side, as when running, is called a stitch.

clue.text: Equally taking care of politician: how to grow crops?

parts.note: c/o, written CO, is the postal abbreviation for care of
MP is a Member of Parliament
arable land grows crops, so crops are grown arably

explanation.surface: A politician being looked after asks, on equal terms, how farming works.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something similarly or in like measure is to do it in a matching way, i.e. equally.

clue.text: Rock salt added to boiled asparagus tips

indicators.note: salt is placed after the letters already taken
the tips of the words boiled and asparagus are their opening letters

explanation.surface: A cook adds rock salt to the tips of boiled asparagus.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rock salt' reads as one ingredient; 'Rock' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Basalt is a dark volcanic stone, an example of the general term.

clue.text: Turned vegetarian food in bowl over

indicators.note: turned signals that the word for the food is read backwards

parts.note: nuts are a staple of vegetarian food

explanation.surface: Vegetarian food in a bowl got knocked over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bowl over' looks like a kitchen accident but means to amaze.
explanation.definitionFit: To astonish or overwhelm someone, figuratively knocking them flat, is to daze them.

clue.text: Cooked, removed bottle top and got drunk

indicators.note: removed signals the bottle's top letter is taken away

parts.note: boiled means cooked

indicators.note: the top of bottle is its first letter

explanation.surface: Someone cooked, uncorked a bottle and got tipsy.
explanation.definitionFit: Oiled is British slang for intoxicated, like 'well-lubricated'.

clue.text: A nut roast served for one on rocket

indicators.note: food that is served is dished up in a new form, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A nut roast is served to someone on a rocket, as if space food.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rocket' suggests the salad leaf beside a nut roast, but it is a spacecraft.
explanation.definitionFit: A space traveller rides aboard a launch vehicle into orbit.

clue.text: Shelter for navy is closed with nurse on board

indicators.note: on board means taken inside, so the nurse goes within the word for closed

parts.note: shut means closed
EN is an enrolled nurse

explanation.surface: A naval shelter is shut up with a nurse aboard.
explanation.definitionFit: A Nissen hut is a prefabricated corrugated-iron military building used for shelter and storage.

clue.text: A vegetarian won't eat one quietly, not cooked, not its head

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical abbreviation for quietly
raw means not cooked

indicators.note: the head of the word not is its first letter

explanation.surface: A vegetarian refuses a shellfish served raw, quietly, with its head removed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not its head' looks like a beheading but means the head of 'not'.
explanation.definitionFit: Shellfish are animal flesh, so a meat-free eater refuses them.

clue.text: Give up almost fat-free greens etc — in short, nothing

indicators.note: almost means the word for fat-free loses its last letter

parts.note: lean meat is free of fat
veg is short for vegetables, greens and the like
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A dieter gives up almost everything except fat-free greens.
explanation.definitionFit: To release one's grip or let something drop is to give it up, an idiom.

clue.text: The French word manger, for example, indicated Welsh vegetarian food

parts.note: la is French for the
manger, French for to eat, is a verb
a meter that read a figure indicated it

explanation.surface: A French lesson: the word manger signalled a Welsh vegetarian dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'manger' looks like a crib, but it is the French verb to eat.
explanation.definitionFit: Laverbread is a Welsh seaweed purée, a traditional meat-free dish.

clue.text: Rescind outdated, pointless tax?

parts.note: to excise is to cut out or remove, as when rescinding a passage

indicators.note: pointless drops a compass point, here south

parts.note: dusty means old-fashioned, outdated

explanation.surface: A call to scrap an outdated, pointless levy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pointless' removes a compass point (S, south) from DUSTY.
explanation.definitionFit: A levy charged on goods produced or sold within a country is a kind of tax.

clue.text: "Boiled rice?" — the vegetarian who believes beans are bad?

definitions.text: vegetarian who believes beans are bad?

indicators.note: boiled suggests the letters are cooked up into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A vegetarian is offered boiled rice and pictured as a bean-sceptic.
explanation.walkthrough: The ancient Pythagoreans shunned beans, so a vegetarian who rejects them dissents from the usual meat-free creed.
explanation.definitionFit: A dissenter from accepted doctrine, here a vegetarian denying the value of beans, is an unbeliever.

clue.text: Programmes ("Morse" is one of them)

definitions.meaning: computer programs are written in instructions for the machine
Morse is a dot-and-dash signalling system

explanation.surface: A TV listing: programmes, with Inspector Morse among them.
explanation.walkthrough: Inspector Morse was a British TV detective series, which makes 'Programmes' look like television.
explanation.definitionFit: Software is written in sets of instructions; Morse is a telegraph signalling system of this kind.

clue.text: From origins in very early days, idealism came of Hindu writing

indicators.note: the origins of words are their opening letters

explanation.surface: Idealism in Hindu scripture arose in very early times.
explanation.definitionFit: The Vedas are the oldest Hindu scriptures, so this adjective describes their texts.

clue.text: Folk culminating in 2 26 across

indicators.note: culminating points to the final letter of Folk

explanation.surface: A cross-reference: folk ending up in one's own family.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Folk' looks like the definition, but supplies only its last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Relatives by birth are one's family members, a synonym of the linked answer.

clue.text: Boatman would move thus, with a labourer's walk, say

indicators.note: say signals a homophone of the phrase that precedes it

parts.note: a navvy is a manual labourer and gait is a way of walking

explanation.surface: The setter Boatman describes his movement as a labourer's swagger.
explanation.walkthrough: Boatman is this puzzle's setter, so the definition describes how a boatman travels.
explanation.definitionFit: A boatman steers a course across water, i.e. pilots a vessel.

clue.text: See 13 down
Cold vegetarian dish excites young man

parts.note: to egg on is to excite or urge
a lad is a young man; the clue leaves the article implied

explanation.surface: A cold dish proves surprisingly thrilling to a young man.
explanation.walkthrough: EGGS A LAD: the clue omits the 'a' that the wordplay needs.
explanation.definitionFit: Chopped boiled eggs in mayonnaise make a chilled meat-free dish.

clue.text: Dares rest after initially fruitless search

indicators.note: the word for rest comes after the trimmed word
initially fruitless means the word for search loses its first letter

parts.note: to frisk is to search a person
to sit is to rest

explanation.surface: Someone takes a break after a fruitless search.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who dares takes a chance and gambles on the outcome.

clue.text: Valuables taken in war with Mars

definitions.meaning: mars as a verb means ruins or damages

explanation.surface: Mars, god of war, is linked with loot from battle.
explanation.walkthrough: Mars the war god seems to belong with the war booty, but it is the verb meaning damages.
explanation.definitionFit: Plunder of war is the victor's booty; to mar something is to damage or ruin it.

clue.text: Cryptic theme about source of protein in Indonesian food

indicators.note: about places the scrambled letters around the source letter
cryptic means obscured or puzzling, so the letters are scrambled
the source of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A puzzle's hidden theme concerns a protein source in Indonesian cooking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts TEMEH (THEME rearranged, from 'Cryptic') around P.
explanation.definitionFit: Tempeh is fermented soya cake from Java, a protein staple of that cuisine.

clue.text: Goes a long way with veg and soya mince

indicators.note: to mince is to chop up finely, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Soya mince with veg makes a little go a long way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Goes a long way' reads as stretching food; it is the definition, a noun phrase for long journeys.
explanation.definitionFit: Long journeys, especially by sea, are trips that cover great distances.

clue.text: See 2
Pulse and bean starter to have for supper

indicators.note: the starter of bean is its opening letter

parts.note: to have something for supper is to eat it

explanation.surface: Pulses and a bean starter planned for the evening meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pulse' looks like a legume but means a heartbeat.
explanation.definitionFit: A pulse is a rhythmic throb, the same as a regular beat.

clue.text: Little chap separated from master wizard, about 99, with his staff

parts.note: MA is a Master of Arts

indicators.note: about means the trimmed wizard's name goes round the next letters
separated from means the chap's name is taken out of the wizard's

parts.note: Gandalf is Tolkien's wizard
Alf, short for Alfred, is a little name for a chap
IC is a loose Roman numeral for 99 (100 less 1)

explanation.surface: An old wizard and his little helper part, the wizard leaning on his staff.
explanation.walkthrough: The wizard is Tolkien's; 'Little chap' is the short name Alf. IC for 99 is an informal Roman numeral (one before a hundred), and the definition relies on the wizard of the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A wizard's staff is the rod he uses to work spells, an object belonging to the 'his'.

clue.text: One who cooks a quiche for you to sample

indicators.note: to sample is to take a small part, so the letters sit within the words quiche for

explanation.surface: A cook offers a quiche for someone to taste.
explanation.definitionFit: A professional cook in a kitchen is known by this French-derived title.

clue.text: Flower mainly used in Indian food

indicators.note: mainly means most of the flower's name is kept, the end dropped

parts.note: a dahlia is a garden flower

explanation.surface: A flower is used mostly in an Indian dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flower' could be a river, but here it is the dahlia.
explanation.definitionFit: Dahl is a lentil stew, a staple Indian dish also spelt dal or dhal.

clue.text: Everyone about to back model source of veg

indicators.note: about places the reversed word inside the word for everyone

parts.note: all men means everyone

indicators.note: back signals that to is read backwards

parts.note: the Model T was Ford's famous car

explanation.surface: Everyone returns to model a vegetable source.
explanation.walkthrough: An allotment is a small rented plot in Britain where people grow their own vegetables.
explanation.definitionFit: A rented garden plot is where many British gardeners grow vegetables.

clue.text: Bitcoin to lose value after middlemen run out?

indicators.note: the trimmed word comes after the middle letter

parts.note: the middle of the word men is its central letter

indicators.note: out signals that the run letter is removed

parts.note: to crash is to lose value suddenly
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: Bitcoin loses value once the middlemen run off.
explanation.definitionFit: Bitcoin is an example of electronic money used online.
